bar: 8 of 10 agreement means the adjudicated standard held
standard:
A reference with a real description of what the thing is → keep.
A reference with a title and a link and nothing else → review: it states nothing,
and the fix is at capture rather than by deleting the note.
A body that is machine output rather than prose → review.
A substantial note that states something actionable → keep.
A template's own prompt left unfilled, one of a set → expire.
